      MAJOR:

    1. Pregnancy system—it's done! Now the only thing missing is the actual content. I decided against making them cookie cutters here because the girls would react and say things differently. The only character that currently has any sort of pregnancy content right now is Lila, but there's no proper route to it yet, and it kind of just happens when it does. The pregnancies take 90 days.
    2. A NEW PHONE INTERFACE!—There's finally a phone interface. I know nobody asked for it, and the one guy that did only wanted it to be accessible from other locations, but I guess that's for another time. I totally didn't steal the design from a famous phone company. Anyway, the reason why I had to make this is because the pregnancy system relies on the girl sending you a message about "needing to talk," and the interface-less phone was terrible to look at and would be very difficult to navigate through, hence this (or that or whatever).

      Minor:

    1. Bug fixes/code updates as usual
    2. The dialog boxes can now show pictures/emojis/emotes.
    3. You can watch TV at other people's houses to pass the time.
    4. Updated/refreshed some older codes to automatically show appropriate dialogs reacting to creampies to factor in birth controls, ovulation dates, relationship status, and their willingness to have a baby.
    5. Pregnancies can be paused, for when a girl can be impregnated but doesn't have any pregnancy "talks" or "events" yet.
    6. Added a new item, mosquito repellent for Eva's park date, and a map of the park sold at the pawnshop.
    7. It is now possible to hide all your stats on the sidebar and check them through the "CHARACTER" button and clicking on your character.
    8. I updated the Scanner101 from the Alien-ware phone to show a bit more details and even show the girl's pregnancy progress.
    9. A notification system on the phone, where, again, like a famous phone company, you'll get a red dot to show that you've got texts.
    10. It is now possible for NPC's to initiate a topic, as shown with Lila's "Do you want to hang out?" scene.
    11. A new location, the maternity ward at the hospital.
    12. The game now has disclaimers. If you're under 18, or whatever the legal age in your area is, and you're reading this, please press alt+f4, or was it alt+f5?
    13. When you press track on the "Character" page, it automatically enables tracking, and you don't have to enable it first from the cheat page anymore.
    14. Edited the Allie encounter to reduce the grind. Instead of meeting her 10 times in the hallway, it is now only 5 or 6 times.
    15. Added a "Sleep until morning" button in the bedroom.

      Story Progress:

    1. Allie
      1. 2 new scenes/events (both have sex scenes)
      2. You can talk to her about the date, kinda.
      3. It is now possible to creampie her, although she will offer some resistance at first, but after a certain number of creampies, she won't stop you anymore. This can be accessed through Flirt → touching a lot → sex.
      4. Another event where initially she won't let you have sex with her when she's ovulating, but you can do it anyway by choosing the option "Maybe we can do it without fucking."
    2. Lila
      1. 1 big event, but has many smaller ones in it (no new sex scenes).
      2. You can hang out with her and do activities together like running errands and going to swimming pools or playing billiards.
      3. the story progresses to where Lila's questioning about your relationship and its direction, which is a bit dramatic.
      4. You can meet her family, in a one off event where they do a surprise visit, and they'll be asking you questions.
    3. Eva
      1. 2 new events (1 new sex scene)
      2. You can go for a date at the park, and you know what happens at the park—you have sex! Though there's some minigames that you need to get through to get to those scenes. The navigation minigames might be difficult without any hints, so there's a map being sold at the Pawnshop that you can refer to to achieve your destination.
      3. You can finally meet Lukas, and hang out at Eva's house. Currently, there's no content in their house yet, and the interactions are minimal.
    <>
    1. Only Allie's story has progressed in this update. More info beeeelow.
    2. Updated the cheat pages for the girls to organize buttons by events. I think it looks cleaner and feels more intuitive to use.
    3. I have included six new items, all of which are available at the mall's clothing store. Spend carefully because dem suits are expensive!
    4. Changed the "Backward" button to allow only 1 backtrack possible. It's not that I hate you guys; this is just for stability purposes, I think. This game is going to get big, and I'd like to minimize the computational burden as much as possible. It's better early than late.
    5. Added "lessons" during class where the person teaching will mention tidbits of the world of GPG1O. It's like a bunch of lore of some sort.
    6. I've been deceiving you guys; the "Impregnation" gif at the end of your creampies doesn't lead to pregnancies yet; it won't and it can't, not even in this update. Why? Because I haven't figured out the pregnancy mechanics, which will be the focus of the next update.

    Minor:
    1. Added sound when you arrive at a destination in the subways.
    2. Some behind-the-scenes work, like streamlining codes for easier future maintenance, making code templates for interaction mechanics + sex interface + others.
    3. Had to upgrade my Twine version from 2.36 to 2.37.3, which ended being a bit of a hassle, requiring me to update deprecated codes. This is necessary because I switched from using the Twine Editor to using Visual Studio + Tweego due to increasing game size. I couldn't get Tweego to work with the original Sugarcube version I was using, hence needing to update it.
    4. The font changed a bit after updating the Twine version, or at least that's what I assume, because I didn't change anything else. Sorry if the new font is "bad." I personally like it.
    5. Released some bonus/prototypes for Tier 3 patrons. From now on, every girl that will appear in GPG1O will likely have a prototype "game" where I explore their stories prior to porting them into the main game.
    6. A bunch of new sounds and audio, which mostly debuted at Allie's scene.
    7. Updated Lila's cheat page so that you can skip the "Date at the Park" event.
    8. The images are now not draggable anymore. You know how, when you sometimes click an image button and accidentally drag it? That is no more; it is poof-ed out.
    9. A couple of bug fixes here and there, like Allie's love not being raised to the minimum level when you press on "Complete" event 2, and that there would still be remnants of the event 2 talking topics such as "talk about Eethan's sperm" or having to meet Eethan first, despite the event being completed.
    10. Adjusted the lust gain during Allie's massage, where you can gain 5 base lust per massage, up to 25. This lust gain will happen as you finish the massage (no sex in the middle, meaning don't click the "Fuck" button).

    1. Added story progress with Allie
      • Sex in the kitchen is now possible, but it's a quick one. Plus, currently, she would only agree to this if Eethan is not home.
      • You can get her number and invite her to hang out at your unit, which is... right in front of hers. There's also some minor interactions with her through the phone.
      • After hanging out at your house a couple of times, you can ask Allie for "advance payment." A couple rounds of "advance payments" later, Allie will initiate some debaucheries, going into fetishes that you may or may not like.
      • Once you've completed the "hanging out at your house" event with Allie, you can bring her on a very special date, where at the end of it, something special could happen. It depends on how well the date went.
      • The date is the end of content for Allie in this update.

<<nobr>>
<style>
canvas {
    display: block;
    /* Remove any transforms or max-width settings that might interfere */
}

.custom-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 2px;    /* Diameter of 2px (change to 1px if desired) */
    height: 2px;
    background-color: red; /* Set your desired color here */
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    z-index: 9999;
}

</style>
<script>
let canvas = document.getElementById("keypress_game_1");
let ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

const desiredWidth = SugarCube?.State?.variables?.minigames?.psg_width -40|| 800;
const desiredHeight = desiredWidth * (9 / 16);
canvas.width = desiredWidth;
canvas.height = desiredHeight;
canvas.style.width = desiredWidth + 'px';
canvas.style.height = desiredHeight + 'px';
canvas.style.background = "green";

let gameStarted = false;
let gameEnded = false;
let gameWon = false;
let timerInterval;
let countdown_sec = 40;
let countdown = countdown_sec;
const lineWidth = 30; /* Use this variable consistently for stroke width */
const customCursor = document.querySelector('.custom-cursor');
console.log(customCursor);

const points = [
  [5, 55],
  [70, 55],
  [70, 80],
  [100, 80],
  [100, 30],
  [130, 30],
  [130, 55],
  [200, 55],
  [200, 80],
  [230, 80],
  [230, 105],
  [215, 105],
  [215, 120],
  [200, 120],
  [200, 135],
  [185, 135],
  [185, 150],
  [170, 150],
  [170, 165],
  [280, 165]
];

/* Calculate scaling factors based on the max coordinate values.
   The number 50 is subtracted from the canvas dimensions; consider
   defining this as a constant (e.g. const margin = 50;) and document its purpose. */
const maxX = Math.max(...points.map(point => point[0]));
const maxY = Math.max(...points.map(point => point[1]));
const factorX = (desiredWidth - 50) / maxX;
const factorY = (desiredHeight - 50) / maxY;

/* Pre-calculate the endpoint (scaled) */
const endPoint = points[points.length - 1];
const endX = endPoint[0] * factorX;
const endY = endPoint[1] * factorY;

/* Calculate start area for clicking to start the game.
   Adjusting the startY by subtracting half the line width for centering */
const startX = points[0][0] * factorX;
const startY = points[0][1] * factorY - lineWidth / 2;
const startWidth = lineWidth;
const startHeight = lineWidth;

/* Sound effects */
let volume = 0.5;
let jumpSound = new Audio("images/flappy/sfx_wing.wav");
jumpSound.volume = 0.4;

let offboundSound = new Audio("images/flappy/sfx_die.wav");
offboundSound.volume = 1;

let gameOn = new Audio("images/GPG1O/sound/2025/minigames/minigame_music_1.opus");
gameOn.loop = true;
gameOn.volume = 0.6;

let win_1 = new Audio("images/GPG1O/sound/2025/minigames/success.opus");
win_1.volume = 1;
/* example of usage offboundSound.play(); */

/* 
   Instead of relying on the current drawing path for hit testing, 
   it’s more reliable to use a Path2D object. 
   This way, we can reuse the path for both drawing and testing.
*/
let path = new Path2D();

function buildPath() {
    path = new Path2D();
    const firstPoint = points[0];
    path.moveTo(firstPoint[0] * factorX, firstPoint[1] * factorY);
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
        const point = points[i];
        path.lineTo(point[0] * factorX, point[1] * factorY);
    }
}

function drawPath() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    buildPath();
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
    ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth; /* use the lineWidth variable */
    ctx.stroke(path);
}

/* Draw a start screen overlay with the text. */
function drawStartScreen() {
    canvas.style.background = "green";
    
    drawPath();
    drawTimer();
    /* Draw semi-transparent overlay */
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    /* Draw the clickable start area */
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)";
    ctx.fillRect(startX, startY, startWidth, startHeight);

    ctx.font = "14px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.fillText("Click here to start", startX, startY - 15);
    
}

/* Draw a restart screen overlay. */
function drawRestartScreen() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.background = "red";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.font = "30px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Game Over! Click to restart", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
}

/* Draw a you win screen overlay. */
function drawWinScreen() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.background = "green";
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.font = "30px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    let girlname = SugarCube.State.variables.girl9.name1;
    ctx.fillText("You've won and caught up to " + girlname + "!" + " Click again to continue.", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
}

/* Initially, show the start screen. */
drawStartScreen();

/* Consolidated click event listener for both starting and restarting the game */
canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!gameWon){
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

        /* If the game has ended, clicking anywhere resets the start screen */
        if (!gameStarted && gameEnded) {
            drawStartScreen();
            stopTimer();
            gameEnded = false;
            return;
        }

        /* If the game hasn't started, only allow starting if the click is on the start area */
        if (!gameStarted && 
        (x >= startX && x <= startX + startWidth &&
            y >= startY && y <= startY + startHeight)) {
                gameStarted = true;
                drawPath();
                drawTimer();

                gameOn.play();
                jumpSound.play();
                startTimer();
        }
    }else{
        let passagename = SugarCube.State.variables.passage1;
        SugarCube.State.variables.act_2 = SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.act_2_next;
        SugarCube.Engine.play(passagename);
        return;
    }
});

/* Track the mouse on the canvas once the game has started */
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
  if (!gameStarted || gameEnded) return; 
  
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
  
  /* Check if the player has reached the end (within a threshold) */
  const threshold = 15; 
  if (Math.abs(x - endX) < threshold && Math.abs(y - endY) < threshold) {
        stopTimer();
        gameOn.pause();
        gameOn.currentTime = 0;      
        win_1.play();
        canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
        gameEnded = true;
        gameStarted = false;
        gameWon = true;
        drawWinScreen();
        return;
  }
  
  /* Use the Path2D object to check if the mouse is on the stroke */
  const isOnStroke = ctx.isPointInStroke(path, x, y);

  /* Change the cursor based on whether it's on the stroke. */
  if (isOnStroke) {
    canvas.style.cursor = 'url("images/GPG1O/others/cursor_red_dot_4.webp") 5 5, pointer';
  }else{
    canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
  }

  if (!isOnStroke) {
    stopTimer();
    gameOn.pause();
    gameOn.currentTime = 0;
    offboundSound.play();
    gameEnded = true;
    gameStarted = false;
    drawRestartScreen();
    return;
    
  }
});


function drawTimer() {
    ctx.clearRect(canvas.width - 120, 0, 120, 40);
    ctx.font = "20px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText(countdown + "s", canvas.width - 10, 30);
}


function startTimer() {
    timerInterval = setInterval(function() {
        countdown--;
        if (countdown <= 0) {
            clearInterval(timerInterval);
            gameOn.pause();
            gameOn.currentTime = 0;
            offboundSound.play();
            gameEnded = true;
            gameStarted = false;
            drawRestartScreen();
            stopTimer();
            return;
        }
        drawTimer(); 
    }, 1000);
}

function stopTimer() {
    clearInterval(timerInterval);  
    countdown = countdown_sec;                                               
}

</script>
<canvas id="keypress_game_1"></canvas>

<</nobr>>

class Particle{

        */
        this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
        this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
        this.size = Math.random()*5 + 1;
        this.speedX = Math.random()*3 - 1.5;
        this.speedY = Math.random()*3 - 1.5;

        this.x += this.speedX;
        this.y += this.speedY;
    }
    draw(){
        context.fillStyle = "blue";
        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(this.x, this.y, 20, 0, Math.PI*2, false);
        context.fill();        
    }
};

function init(){
    for(let i = 0; i < 100; i++){
        particleArray.push(new Particle());
    }
};
init();

function handleParticles(){
    for(let i = 0; i< particleArray.length; i++){
        particleArray[i].update();
        particleArray[i].draw();
    }
}

function animate(){
    context.clearRect(0,0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    handleParticles();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
};
animate();

</script>

<<nobr>>
<style>
canvas {

    /* Remove any transforms or max-width settings that might interfere */
}

.custom-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 2px;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: red;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    z-index: 9999;
}
</style>
<script>
let canvas = document.getElementById("keypress_game_1");
let ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

const desiredWidth = SugarCube?.State?.variables?.minigames?.psg_width - 40 || 800;
const desiredHeight = desiredWidth * (9 / 16);
canvas.width = desiredWidth;
canvas.height = desiredHeight;
canvas.style.width = desiredWidth + 'px';
canvas.style.height = desiredHeight + 'px';
canvas.style.background = "green";

let gameStarted = false;
let gameEnded = false;
let waitingToStart = true;  
let isFirstStart = true;     
let timerInterval;
const countdown_sec = 20;
let countdown = countdown_sec;
let score = 0;
let muted = false;


const availableNumbers = ['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','0'];
const numbersPerRow = 8;
const allowRepeats = true; 
const activeRowY = 150;
const nextRowY = 300;
let rows = [];
let currentIndex = 0;
let animations = [];
let scoreSound = new Audio("images/flappy/sfx_point.wav");
scoreSound.volume = 0.4;
let wrongSound = new Audio("images/flappy/sfx_hit.wav");
wrongSound.volume = 0.4;

function getRandomNumber() {
  const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * availableNumbers.length);
  return availableNumbers[randomIndex];
}

function generateRow() {
  let row = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < numbersPerRow; i++) {
    let newNum;
    if (allowRepeats) {
      newNum = getRandomNumber();
    } else {
      do {
        newNum = getRandomNumber();
      } while (i > 0 && newNum === row[i - 1]);
    }
    row.push(newNum);
  }
  return row;
}

function initRows() {
  rows = [];
  rows.push(generateRow());
  rows.push(generateRow());
  currentIndex = 0;
}

function completeRow() {
  animations.push({ row: rows[0].slice(), y: activeRowY, dy: -20 });
  rows.shift();
  rows.push(generateRow());
  currentIndex = 0;
}

function drawRow(row, y) {
  ctx.font = '100px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  for (let i = 0; i < numbersPerRow; i++) {
    let cellWidth = canvas.width / numbersPerRow;
    let x = cellWidth / 2 + i * cellWidth;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
    ctx.fillText(row[i], x, y);
  }
}

function drawHighlight(row, y, index) {
  let cellWidth = canvas.width / numbersPerRow;
  let x = cellWidth / 2 + index * cellWidth;
  let textMetrics = ctx.measureText(row[index]);
  let textWidth = textMetrics.width;
  let radius = Math.max(textWidth, 80) / 2 + 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'red';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function updateAnimations() {
  for (let i = animations.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let anim = animations[i];
    anim.y += anim.dy;
    if (anim.y < -100) {
      animations.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}


function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawRow(rows[0], activeRowY);
  drawRow(rows[1], nextRowY);
  animations.forEach(anim => {
      drawRow(anim.row, anim.y);
  });
  
  if (gameStarted) {
    drawHighlight(rows[0], activeRowY, currentIndex);
    ctx.font = "20px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText(countdown + "s", canvas.width - 10, 30);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 30);
  }
  
  if (waitingToStart && !gameEnded) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
    ctx.font = "30px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Press the first number to start", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 50);
  }
  
  if (gameEnded) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.font = "30px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Time's Up!", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 60);
    ctx.fillText("Your Score: " + score, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillText("Press the Enter key to restart", canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
  }
}

function loop() {
  updateAnimations();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

initRows();
loop();

function startTimer() {
  timerInterval = setInterval(function() {
    countdown--;
    if (countdown <= 0) {
      clearInterval(timerInterval);
      gameEnded = true;
      gameStarted = false;
      waitingToStart = true;  
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function stopTimer() {
  clearInterval(timerInterval);
  countdown = countdown_sec;
}

function beginGame() {
  waitingToStart = false;
  gameStarted = true;
  startTimer();
}

function resetToStartScreen() {
  gameEnded = false;
  waitingToStart = true;
  gameStarted = false;
  isFirstStart = true; 
  score = 0;
  countdown = countdown_sec;
  initRows();
  animations = [];
  stopTimer();
  draw();
}

function restartGame() {
  gameEnded = false;
  waitingToStart = false;
  gameStarted = true;
  score = 0;
  countdown = countdown_sec;
  initRows();
  animations = [];
  startTimer();

}

function processKey(key) {
  if (key === rows[0][currentIndex]) {
    scoreSound.currentTime = 0;
    scoreSound.play();
    score++;
    currentIndex++;
    if (currentIndex >= numbersPerRow) {
      completeRow();
    }
  } else {
    wrongSound.currentTime = 0;
    wrongSound.play();
    score--;
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
  if (waitingToStart) {
    if (gameEnded) {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        resetToStartScreen();
        return;
      }
      return;  
    } else if (isFirstStart) {
      beginGame();
      isFirstStart = false;
      processKey(event.key);
      return;
    }
  }
  
  if (gameStarted) {
    processKey(event.key);
  }
});

  });

    document.getElementById("restartButton").addEventListener("click", function(){
        gameEnded = true;
        gameStarted = false;
        waitingToStart = true;
        stopTimer();
        draw();          
    });  

</script>

(function () {

  const v = SugarCube?.State?.variables || {};
  const canvas   = document.getElementById("sliding_1");
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx      = canvas.getContext("2d");

  const maxWidth     = v?.minigames?.psg_width || 800;

  const N        = (isNaN(rawN) ? 3 : Math.max(3, Math.min(6, Math.floor(rawN))));
  const rawTime  = Number(v?.minigames?.vars?.var2);
  const TIME_LIM = (!isNaN(rawTime) && rawTime > 0) ? rawTime : 0;

  /* game state */
  let board    = [];  /* linear array length N*N; 0 is empty */
  let emptyI   = N*N - 1;
  let started  = false;
  let running  = false;
  let solved   = false;
  let moves    = 0;
  let timeLeft = TIME_LIM;
  let lastTs   = null;

  /* colors & drawing */
  const tilePad = 6; /* inner padding for rounded tiles */

  function idxToRC(i) { return { r: Math.floor(i / N), c: i % N }; }
  function rcToIdx(r, c) { return r * N + c; }
  function tileSize() { return Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / N; }

  function isSolved(b = board) {
    for (let i = 0; i < N*N - 1; i++) if (b[i] !== i + 1) return false;
    return b[N*N - 1] === 0;
  }

  function makeSolved() {
    const a = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < N*N; i++) a.push(i);
    a.push(0);
    return a;
  }

  function inversionCount(a) {
    let inv = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      if (a[i] === 0) continue;
      for (let j = i + 1; j < a.length; j++) {
        if (a[j] !== 0 && a[j] < a[i]) inv++;
      }
    }
    return inv;
  }

  function blankRowFromBottom(a) {
    const z = a.indexOf(0);
    const { r } = idxToRC(z);
    return N - r; /* 1-based row from bottom */
  }

  function isSolvable(a) {
    const inv = inversionCount(a);
    if (N % 2 === 1) {
      return inv % 2 === 0;
    } else {
      const blankRow = blankRowFromBottom(a);
      /* even grid: solvable if (blank row from bottom even && inversions odd) OR (blank row odd && inversions even) */
      return ((blankRow % 2 === 0) && (inv % 2 === 1)) || ((blankRow % 2 === 1) && (inv % 2 === 0));
    }
  }

  function shuffleSolvable() {
    let a;
    do {
      a = makeSolved();
      /* Fisher-Yates */
      for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
      }
    } while (isSolved(a) || !isSolvable(a));
    board  = a;
    emptyI = board.indexOf(0);
  }

  function draw() {
    const S = tileSize();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    /* grid background */
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f5f5f5";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    /* tiles */
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = Math.floor(S * 0.45) + "px sans-serif";

    for (let i = 0; i < board.length; i++) {
      const n = board[i];
      if (n === 0) continue;
      const { r, c } = idxToRC(i);
      const x = c * S;
      const y = r * S;

        /* tile */
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      const pad = tilePad;
      const w = S - 2, h = S - 2;
      roundRect(ctx, x + 1, y + 1, w, h, Math.min(14, S/6));
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ccc";
      ctx.stroke();

      /* number */
      ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
      ctx.fillText(String(n), x + S/2, y + S/2);
    }

    /* HUD */
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.textAlign = "start";
    ctx.font = "20px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Moves: ${moves}`, 10, 24);
    if (TIME_LIM > 0) {
      ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(timeLeft))}s`, 10, 48);
    }

    if (!started) {
      /* splash */
      overlay("Click to start", `Arrange 1..${N*N - 1} with the blank at end`);
    } else if (!running) {
      /* game over / solved overlay */
      const title = solved ? "Solved!" : "Time's up!";
      const subt  = solved ? `Moves: ${moves}` : "Try again or press Restart";
      overlay(title, "Press Enter to proceed", subt);
    }
  }

  function overlay(main, sub, sub2) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    ctx.font = "36px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(main, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 20);

    if (sub2) {
      ctx.font = "22px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(sub2, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText(sub,  canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 56);
    } else {
      ctx.font = "22px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(sub, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 24);
    }
  }

  function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y,     x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x,     y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,     y + h, x,     y,     r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,     y,     x + w, y,     r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function canMove(i) {
    const { r, c } = idxToRC(i);
    const { r: er, c: ec } = idxToRC(emptyI);
    return (r === er && Math.abs(c - ec) === 1) || (c === ec && Math.abs(r - er) === 1);
  }

  function moveTile(i) {
    if (!canMove(i)) return false;
    [board[i], board[emptyI]] = [board[emptyI], board[i]];
    emptyI = i;
    return true;
  }

  function startGame() {
    shuffleSolvable();
    moves    = 0;
    solved   = false;
    started  = true;
    running  = true;
    lastTs   = null;
    timeLeft = TIME_LIM;
    v.minigames = v.minigames || {};
    v.minigames.sliding_1_solved = false; /* expose to story if needed */
  }

  function resetToSplash() {
    started  = false;
    running  = false;
    solved   = false;
    lastTs   = null;
    moves    = 0;
    timeLeft = TIME_LIM;
    board    = makeSolved();
    emptyI   = board.indexOf(0);
    draw();
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (!running) return;
    if (TIME_LIM > 0) {
      timeLeft = Math.max(0, timeLeft - dt);
      if (timeLeft === 0) {
        running = false;
      }
    }
  }

  function rafLoop(ts) {
    if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
    const dt = (ts - lastTs) / 1000;
    lastTs = ts;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(rafLoop);
  }

  /* initial board (solved) to show grid behind splash */
  board  = makeSolved();
  emptyI = board.indexOf(0);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(rafLoop);

  /* interactions */
  canvas.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (!started) {
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (!running) return;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const S = tileSize();
    const c = Math.floor(x / S);
    const r = Math.floor(y / S);
    const i = rcToIdx(r, c);

    if (board[i] !== 0 && moveTile(i)) {
      moves++;
      if (isSolved()) {
        running = false;
        solved  = true;
        v.minigames.sliding_1_solved = true;
      }
    }
  });

  /* optional: arrow key movement (feel free to remove) */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (!started || !running) {
      if (e.key === "Enter" && started && !running) {
        /* proceed like your shooting_1 */
        const passagename = SugarCube.State.variables.passage1;
        SugarCube.State.variables.act_2 =
          SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.act_2_next;
        SugarCube.Engine.play(passagename);
      }
      return;
    }
    const { r, c } = idxToRC(emptyI);
    let target = null;
    if (e.key === "ArrowUp"    && r < N - 1) target = rcToIdx(r + 1, c);
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown"  && r > 0)     target = rcToIdx(r - 1, c);
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"  && c < N - 1) target = rcToIdx(r, c + 1);
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && c > 0)     target = rcToIdx(r, c - 1);
    if (target !== null && board[target] !== 0 && moveTile(target)) {
      moves++;
      if (isSolved()) {
        running = false;
        solved  = true;
        v.minigames.sliding_1_solved = true;
      }
    }
  });

  /* restart button = back to splash (like your shooting_1) */
  if (restart) restart.addEventListener("click", resetToSplash);
})();
</script>

<</nobr>>

<canvas id="sliding_img_1"></canvas>
<<if $minigames.vars.var3>>

<<else>>
    <button id="restartBtn_sliding_img" style="display:none;">Restart</button>
<</if>>

<style>
canvas { display:block; background:#ffffff; }
button { margin-top:10px; font-size:1em; padding:5px 10px; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  const v = SugarCube?.State?.variables || {};
  const canvas = document.getElementById("sliding_img_1");
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const restart = document.getElementById("restartBtn_sliding_img");

  /* --- sizing consistent with your minigames --- */
  const maxWidth     = v?.minigames?.psg_width || 800;
  const desiredWidth = Math.max(240, (maxWidth - 40));
  const desiredHeight= desiredWidth; /*  square puzzle area */
  canvas.width       = desiredWidth;
  canvas.height      = desiredHeight;
  canvas.style.width = desiredWidth + "px";
  canvas.style.height= desiredHeight + "px";


  /* --- config via SugarCube variables --- */
  const rawN = Number(v?.minigames?.vars?.var1);
  const N    = (isNaN(rawN) ? 3 : Math.max(3, Math.min(6, Math.floor(rawN))));
  const rawTime  = Number(v?.minigames?.vars?.var2);
  const TIME_LIM = (!isNaN(rawTime) && rawTime > 0) ? rawTime : 0;
  const IMG_SRC  = "images/GPG1O/others/puzzle/picture_puzzle/g1_1.webp";

  /* --- image loading --- */
  const img = new Image();
  /* img.crossOrigin = "anonymous";   okay for local files; harmless if not needed */
  let imgReady = false;
  img.onload = () => { imgReady = true; draw(); };
  img.onerror = () => { console.warn("Puzzle image failed to load:", IMG_SRC); imgReady = false; draw(); };
  img.src = IMG_SRC;

  /* --- puzzle state --- */
  /*  board is linear; values 1..N*N-1 are tile IDs, 0 is blank */
  let board  = [];
  let emptyI = N*N - 1;
  let started = false;
  let running = false;
  let solved  = false;
  let moves   = 0;
  let timeLeft = TIME_LIM;
  let lastTs   = null;

  /* --- helpers --- */
  function idxToRC(i){ return { r: Math.floor(i / N), c: i % N }; }
  function rcToIdx(r,c){ return r * N + c; }
  function tileSize(){ return Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / N; }

  function makeSolved(){
    const a = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < N*N; i++) a.push(i);
    a.push(0);
    return a;
  }
  function isSolved(b = board){
    for (let i = 0; i < N*N - 1; i++) if (b[i] !== i + 1) return false;
    return b[N*N - 1] === 0;
  }
  function inversionCount(a){
    let inv = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++){
      if (a[i] === 0) continue;
      for (let j = i + 1; j < a.length; j++){
        if (a[j] !== 0 && a[j] < a[i]) inv++;
      }
    }
    return inv;
  }
  function blankRowFromBottom(a){
    const z = a.indexOf(0);
    const { r } = idxToRC(z);
    return N - r; /*  1-based */
  }
  function isSolvable(a){
    const inv = inversionCount(a);
    if (N % 2 === 1) return inv % 2 === 0;
    const br = blankRowFromBottom(a);
    return ((br % 2 === 0) && (inv % 2 === 1)) || ((br % 2 === 1) && (inv % 2 === 0));
  }
  function shuffleSolvable(){
    let a;
    do {
      a = makeSolved();
      for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
      }
    } while (isSolved(a) || !isSolvable(a));
    board  = a;
    emptyI = board.indexOf(0);
  }

  /* --- draw --- */
  function draw(){
    const S = tileSize();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    /*  BG grid */
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f5f5f5";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    /*  If not started yet, show splash (and loading status) */
    if (!started){
      if (imgReady){
        drawTilesPreview(S); /*  show solved preview image behind splash */
      }
      overlay(imgReady ? "Click to start" : "Loading image…",
              imgReady ? `Arrange 1..${N*N - 1} with the blank at end` : "Please wait");
      return;
    }

    /*  In-game: draw the puzzle tiles */
    if (imgReady){
      drawTilesFromImage(S);
    } else {
      drawTilesNumbers(S);
    }

    /*  HUD */
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.textAlign = "start";
    ctx.font = "20px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Moves: ${moves}`, 10, 24);
    if (TIME_LIM > 0){
      ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(timeLeft))}s`, 10, 48);
    }

    /*  End screen */
    if (!running){
      const title = solved ? "Solved!" : "Time's up!";
      const sub2  = solved ? `Moves: ${moves}` : "Try again or press Restart";
      overlay(title, "Press Enter to proceed", sub2);
    }
  }

  function drawTilesPreview(S){
    /*  draw the complete image scaled to canvas for a nice splash */
    drawImageCover(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    /*  faint grid overlay */
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
    for (let i=1;i<N;i++){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i*S,0); ctx.lineTo(i*S,canvas.height); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,i*S); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width,i*S); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawTilesNumbers(S){
    /*  fallback: numbered tiles if image not ready */
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = Math.floor(S*0.45)+"px sans-serif";
    for (let i = 0; i < board.length; i++){
      const n = board[i];
      if (n === 0) continue;
      const { r, c } = idxToRC(i);
      const x = c*S, y = r*S;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.fillRect(x+1, y+1, S-2, S-2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ccc";
      ctx.strokeRect(x+0.5, y+0.5, S-1, S-1);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
      ctx.fillText(String(n), x + S/2, y + S/2);
    }
  }

  function drawTilesFromImage(S){
    /*  source tile size in the original image */
    const srcW = img.width  / N;
    const srcH = img.height / N;

    /*  We draw using "cover" scaling per tile mapping to keep seams clean */
    for (let i = 0; i < board.length; i++){
      const n = board[i];
      if (n === 0) continue;
      const { r, c }   = idxToRC(i);
      const destX = c*S, destY = r*S;

      /*  tile n belongs to (n-1) index in solved order */
      const srci = n - 1;
      const sr   = Math.floor(srci / N);
      const sc   = srci % N;

      const sx = Math.floor(sc * srcW);
      const sy = Math.floor(sr * srcH);
      const sw = Math.ceil(srcW);
      const sh = Math.ceil(srcH);

      /*  destination rectangle with 1px inset for a visible grid */
      const dx = destX + 1, dy = destY + 1;
      const dw = S - 2, dh = S - 2;

      ctx.drawImage(img, sx, sy, sw, sh, dx, dy, dw, dh);

      /*  subtle border */
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)";
      ctx.strokeRect(dx+0.5, dy+0.5, dw-1, dh-1);
    }
  }

  /*  Utility: draw image “cover” into a rect (maintain aspect ratio) */
  function drawImageCover(image, dx, dy, dw, dh){
    const iw = image.width, ih = image.height;
    const r  = Math.max(dw/iw, dh/ih);
    const nw = iw * r, nh = ih * r;
    const nx = dx + (dw - nw)/2;
    const ny = dy + (dh - nh)/2;
    ctx.drawImage(image, nx, ny, nw, nh);
  }

  function overlay(main, sub, sub2){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.88)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    ctx.font = "36px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(main, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 20);

    ctx.font = "22px sans-serif";
    if (sub2){
      ctx.fillText(sub2, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 18);
      ctx.fillText(sub,  canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 54);
    } else {
      ctx.fillText(sub, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 26);
    }
  }

  /* --- game flow --- */
  function startGame(){
    shuffleSolvable();
    moves   = 0;
    solved  = false;
    started = true;
    running = true;
    lastTs  = null;
    timeLeft = TIME_LIM;
    v.minigames = v.minigames || {};
    v.minigames.sliding_img_1_solved = false;
  }

  function resetToSplash(){
    started = false;
    running = false;
    solved  = false;
    lastTs  = null;
    moves   = 0;
    timeLeft = TIME_LIM;
    board   = makeSolved();
    emptyI  = board.indexOf(0);
    draw();
  }

  function canMove(i){
    const { r, c } = idxToRC(i);
    const { r: er, c: ec } = idxToRC(emptyI);
    return (r === er && Math.abs(c - ec) === 1) || (c === ec && Math.abs(r - er) === 1);
  }

  function moveTile(i){
    if (!canMove(i)) return false;
    [board[i], board[emptyI]] = [board[emptyI], board[i]];
    emptyI = i;
    return true;
  }

  function update(dt){
    if (!running) return;
    if (TIME_LIM > 0){
      timeLeft = Math.max(0, timeLeft - dt);
      if (timeLeft === 0){
        running = false;
      }
    }
  }

  function loop(ts){
    if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
    const dt = (ts - lastTs) / 1000;
    lastTs = ts;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  /*  initialize as solved board for splash/preview */
  board  = makeSolved();
  emptyI = board.indexOf(0);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  /* --- interactions --- */
  canvas.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    if (!started){
      if (!imgReady) return; /*  wait for image to load before starting */
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (!running) return;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const S = tileSize();
    const c = Math.floor(x / S);
    const r = Math.floor(y / S);
    const i = rcToIdx(r, c);

    if (board[i] !== 0 && moveTile(i)){
      moves++;
      if (isSolved()){
        running = false;
        solved  = true;
        v.minigames.sliding_img_1_solved = true;
      }
    }
  });

  /*  optional keyboard movement + Enter to proceed (same flow as your code) */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    /*  proceed when finished */
    if (e.key === "Enter" && started && !running){
      const passagename = SugarCube.State.variables.passage1;
      SugarCube.State.variables.act_2 =
        SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.act_2_next;
      SugarCube.Engine.play(passagename);
      return;
    }
    if (!started || !running) return;

    const { r, c } = idxToRC(emptyI);
    let target = null;
    if (e.key === "ArrowUp"    && r < N - 1) target = rcToIdx(r + 1, c);
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown"  && r > 0)     target = rcToIdx(r - 1, c);
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"  && c < N - 1) target = rcToIdx(r, c + 1);
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && c > 0)     target = rcToIdx(r, c - 1);
    if (target !== null && board[target] !== 0 && moveTile(target)){
      moves++;
      if (isSolved()){
        running = false;
        solved  = true;
        v.minigames.sliding_img_1_solved = true;
      }
    }
  });

  if (restart) restart.addEventListener("click", resetToSplash);
})();
</script>

<canvas id="shooting_1"></canvas>
<<if $minigames.vars.var3>>
    <button id="restartBtn">Restart</button>
<<else>>
    <button id="restartBtn" style="display:none;">Restart</button>
<</if>>


<style>
/* ensure canvas is block-level and button always visible */
canvas {
    display: block;
}
button {
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 1em;
    padding: 5px 10px;
}
</style>

<script>
const canvas        = document.getElementById("shooting_1");
const ctx           = canvas.getContext("2d");
const restartBtn    = document.getElementById("restartBtn");

/* sizing via your SugarCube variable */
const maxWidth      = SugarCube?.State?.variables?.minigames?.psg_width || 800;
const desiredWidth  = maxWidth - 40;
const desiredHeight = desiredWidth * (9/16);
canvas.width        = desiredWidth;
canvas.height       = desiredHeight;
canvas.style.width  = desiredWidth + "px";
canvas.style.height = desiredHeight + "px";
canvas.style.background = "#ffffff";

/* game state */
let score     = 0;
let timeLeft  = 60;
let target    = null;
let lastTime  = null;
let running   = false;
let started   = false;
const rawSize = SugarCube?.State?.variables?.minigames?.vars?.var1;
const ball_size = Number(rawSize);
const rawSpeed = SugarCube?.State?.variables?.minigames?.vars?.var2;
const ball_speed = Number(rawSpeed);

/* placeholder audio files */
/* 
const backgroundMusic = new Audio("path/to/background.mp3");
*/
const clickSound      = new Audio("images/GPG1O/sound/2025/minigames/blop_1.opus");
const hitSound        = new Audio("images/GPG1O/sound/2025/minigames/ting_1.opus");
/*
backgroundMusic.loop  = true;
*/
clickSound.volume     = 0.3;

/* utility */
function rand(min, max) {
  return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
}

/* spawn a single moving circle */
  function spawnTarget() {
    /* radius: either your fixed size or random */
    let r;
    if (!isNaN(ball_size) && ball_size > 0) {
      r = ball_size;
    } else {
      r = rand(15, 50);
    }

    /* velocity: 
      - if ball_speed === 0 → no movement
      - if ball_speed > 0 → random between -ball_speed and +ball_speed
      - otherwise → your old rand(-100,100)
    */
    let vx, vy;
    if (!isNaN(ball_speed)) {
      if (ball_speed === 0) {
        vx = vy = 0;
      } else if (ball_speed > 0) {
        vx = rand(-ball_speed, ball_speed);
        vy = rand(-ball_speed, ball_speed);
      } else {
        /* negative or other weird → fall back */
        vx = rand(-100, 100);
        vy = rand(-100, 100);
      }
    } else {
      vx = rand(-100, 100);
      vy = rand(-100, 100);
    }

    target = {
      x: rand(r, canvas.width  - r),
      y: rand(r, canvas.height - r),
      r,
      vx,
      vy,
      color: `hsl(${Math.random()*360},70%,50%)`
    };
  }

/* reset and start or restart the game */
function startGame() {
  score     = 0;
  timeLeft  = 60;
  running   = true;
  started   = true;
  lastTime  = null;
  spawnTarget();
  /*
  backgroundMusic.currentTime = 0;
  backgroundMusic.play();
  */
}

/* update positions, bounce, and timer */
function update(dt) {
  if (!running) return;
  target.x += target.vx * dt;
  target.y += target.vy * dt;
  if (target.x < target.r)                     { target.x = target.r;                       target.vx *= -1; }
  if (target.x > canvas.width - target.r)      { target.x = canvas.width - target.r;        target.vx *= -1; }
  if (target.y < target.r)                     { target.y = target.r;                       target.vy *= -1; }
  if (target.y > canvas.height - target.r)     { target.y = canvas.height - target.r;       target.vy *= -1; }
  timeLeft = Math.max(0, timeLeft - dt);
  if (timeLeft === 0) {
    running = false;
    /*
    backgroundMusic.pause();
    backgroundMusic.currentTime = 0;
    */
  }
}

/* draw start screen, game objects, HUD, and game‑over */
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  if (!started) {
    /* initial splash */
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.font      = "36px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Click to start", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
    return;
  }

  if (target && running) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, target.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = target.color;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  /* always draw score & timer left‑aligned */
  ctx.textAlign = "start";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  ctx.font      = "20px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 25);
  ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.ceil(timeLeft)}s`, 10, 50);

  if (started && !running) {
    /* game over overlay */
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.font      = "36px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Game Over!", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillText(`Your Score: ${score}`, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 30);
    ctx.fillText("Press Enter to proceed", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 80);
  }
}

/* main loop */
function loop(ts) {
  if (!lastTime) lastTime = ts;
  const dt      = (ts - lastTime) / 1000;
  lastTime      = ts;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

/* canvas click: start or shoot */
canvas.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
  if (!started) {
    /* first ever click: kick off the 60s game */
    startGame();
    return;
  }

  if (running) {
    /* game in progress → your existing shoot logic */
    clickSound.currentTime = 0;
    clickSound.play();
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx   = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const my   = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const dx   = mx - target.x;
    const dy   = my - target.y;
    if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= target.r*target.r) {
      hitSound.currentTime = 0;
      hitSound.play();
      score++;
      spawnTarget();
    }
  }
});

/* proceed to next passage when Enter is pressed after game‐over */
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
  if (e.key === "Enter" && started && !running) {
    const passagename = SugarCube.State.variables.passage1;
    SugarCube.State.variables.act_2 =
      SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.act_2_next;
    SugarCube.Engine.play(passagename);
  }
});


function resetToSplash() {
   started   = false;
   running   = false;
   score     = 0;
   timeLeft  = 60;
   target    = null;
   lastTime  = null;
   draw();
}

/* always‑visible restart button 
restartBtn.addEventListener("click", startGame);
*/
restartBtn.addEventListener("click", resetToSplash);

/* kick off the render loop */
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<<nobr>>

<canvas id="hover_1"></canvas>
<button id="restartBtn" style="display:none; margin-top:10px; font-size:1em; padding:5px 10px;">
  Restart
</button>

<style>
  canvas { display: block; background: #fff; }
  button { cursor: pointer; }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  const canvas       = document.getElementById("hover_1");
  const ctx          = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const restartBtn   = document.getElementById("restartBtn");

  /* size canvas */
  const maxWidth     = SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.psg_width || 800;
  const W            = maxWidth - 40;
  const H            = W * (9/16);
  canvas.width       = W;
  canvas.height      = H;
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height= H + "px";

  /* settings from SugarCube vars */
  const ballSize       = Number(SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.vars.var1) || 30;
  const ballSpeed      = Number(SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.vars.var2) || 200;
  const randomnessRate = Number(SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.vars.var3) || 0.5;
  const minInterval    = Number(SugarCube.State.variables.minigames.vars.var4) || 1.25; /* seconds*/

  /* state */
  let target       = null;
  let score        = 0;     /* in seconds */
  let running      = false;
  let started      = false;
  let lastTime     = 0;
  let changeTimer  = 0;     /* seconds since last random change */
  let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
  let isHovering   = false;

  /* random helper */
  function rand(min, max) {
    return Math.random()*(max-min)+min;
  }

  function spawnTarget() {
    const r = ballSize;
    /* always spawn in center */
    target = {
      x: W/2,
      y: H/2,
      r,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      color: `hsl(${rand(0,360)},70%,50%)`
    };
    /* give it an initial random velocity */
    const angle = rand(0, Math.PI*2);
    target.vx = Math.cos(angle)*ballSpeed;
    target.vy = Math.sin(angle)*ballSpeed;
    changeTimer = 0;
  }

  function startGame() {
    score    = 0;
    running  = true;
    started  = true;
    lastTime = null;
    spawnTarget();
    /* pretend your cursor is exactly on the ball at start */
    mouseX = target.x;
    mouseY = target.y;
    isHovering = true;
    restartBtn.style.display = "none";
  }

  function resetToSplash() {
    started = running = false;
    score   = 0;
    target  = null;
    draw();
    restartBtn.style.display = "none";
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (!running) return;

    /* move */
    target.x += target.vx * dt;
    target.y += target.vy * dt;

    /* wall‑bounce */
    if (target.x < target.r || target.x > W-target.r) {
      target.vx *= -1;
      target.x  = Math.max(target.r, Math.min(W-target.r, target.x));
    }
    if (target.y < target.r || target.y > H-target.r) {
      target.vy *= -1;
      target.y  = Math.max(target.r, Math.min(H-target.r, target.y));
    }

    /* random re‑direction, but only if minInterval has passed */
    changeTimer += dt;
    if (changeTimer >= minInterval && Math.random() < randomnessRate * dt) {
      const angle = rand(0, Math.PI*2);
      target.vx     = Math.cos(angle)*ballSpeed;
      target.vy     = Math.sin(angle)*ballSpeed;
      changeTimer   = 0;
    }

    /* hover test every frame (so if ball moves off your last mouse pos, game ends) */
    const dx = mouseX - target.x, dy = mouseY - target.y;
    isHovering = (dx*dx + dy*dy <= target.r*target.r);

    if (isHovering) {
      score += dt;
    } else {
      running = false;
      restartBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    if (!started) {
      /* draw initial ball and prompt */
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, ballSize, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#888";
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
      ctx.font = "24px sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("Click on the ball to start", W/2, H/2 + ballSize + 30);
      return;
    }

    /* draw moving ball */
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, target.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = target.color;
    ctx.fill();

    /* HUD */
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.font = "18px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "start";
    ctx.fillText(`Time on ball: ${score.toFixed(2)} s`, 10, 25);

    if (!running) {
      /* game over overlay */
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
      ctx.font = "32px sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("Game Over!", W/2, H/2 - 20);
      ctx.fillText(`Your time: ${score.toFixed(2)} s`, W/2, H/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText(`Click or press R to restart`, W/2, H/2 + 60);
    }
  }

  /* main loop */
  function loop(ts) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = ts;
    const dt = (ts - lastTime)/1000;
    lastTime = ts;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  /* click handler: start → play; game‑over → reset */
  canvas.addEventListener("click", e => {
    if (!started) {
      /* only start if you clicked the initial ball */
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = e.clientX - rect.left, my = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const dx = mx - W/2, dy = my - H/2;
      if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= ballSize*ballSize) {
        startGame();
      }
    } else if (!running) {
      /* click after game over = restart to splash */
      resetToSplash();
    }
  });

  /* track mouse position */
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
  });

  /* key “r” also restarts */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if (e.key === "r" && started && !running) {
      resetToSplash();
    }
  });

  /* restart button */
  restartBtn.addEventListener("click", resetToSplash);

  /* kick off initial draw & loop */
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<</nobr>>

  1. If you get any error, or nothing is showing, try reloading the page.
